release_notes: YouTube Growth Analytics now wires directly from the Main window instead of relying on a dynamically discovered WPF Loaded hook.
Rebuilding or revisiting the Analytics section automatically reattaches Growth dashboard wiring and restores the long-form view.
Refresh from YouTube now explicitly waits for public YouTube statistics and the richer Growth Analytics refresh before rendering the final dashboard.
The Analytics page remains long-form first with full-video views/day, average viewed percentage, watch minutes, subscriber change, Growth score and status.
The recommendation card continues to show the next full-video category Growth Autopilot will actually choose.
